prose: In this episode we embark on the latter half of Marvel's Loki series, beginning with Season 2, Episode 1: Ouroboros. Tune in to learn about the esoteric encoding of the Tarot's Fool card, the divine spirit & breath of God, the ancient motif of the crucified savior, the fiction of Black Holes and spaghettification, the mystery of the letter A (Aleph, Alpha, etc.), and a whole lot more. This content will be fascinating and educational even for those who never watched the TV series that we're decoding, so don't miss out!
